About

An Epigenetic Day Care SPF 30 enriched with Epicelline®, based on patented Age Clock Technology, proven to visibly reverse the signs of ageing for younger‑looking skin, while helping to protect against advanced skin ageing.
NART: 99628-09900-00

Our breakthrough anti-age innovation  

Anti-ageing Day Care SPF 30, reverses signs of skin ageing visibly and protects against advanced skin ageing.

Skin ageing is accelerated by lifestyle and environmental factors that change the skin’s epigenetic patterns. This means that youth genes are deactivated, leading to visible signs of ageing.  

After 15 years of epigenetic research, Eucerin has discovered how to reactivate these youth genes based on a patented Age Clock Technology: 

Epicelline® helps to reactivate the skin’s youth genes and allows skin cells to act younger. This mechanism makes the skin look younger than its age and reverses 10 signs of ageing, visibly leading to:  

  • Wrinkles reduction
  • Firmness increase
  • Lfiting effect
  • Pores
  • Fine line reduction
  • Hydration
  • Rejuvenation
  • Radiance
  • Smoothness
  • Evenness

Disclaimer: Clinical study over 2 weeks with 42 volunteers and clincal studies over 4 weeks with 40 and 52 volunteers respectively. 

How to Use

Apply the Day Care SPF 30 as the first step in the morning. For advanced efficacy with 3x power, combine with the Eucerin Epigenetic Serum and Night Care.

BUILD YOUR OWN SKIN PROTOCOL

Apply the Hyaluron‑Filler + Longevity Epigenetic Serum morning and evening to a thoroughly cleansed face. Apply to the face, neck and décolleté, gently massaging into the skin.

Clinical Formula

Hyaluronic acid

Hyaluronic Acid is formed by skin cells and is part of the connective tissue of the skin. One of its key functions is to retain moisture, and it has the ability to bind in between 1,000 and 10,000 times its own weight in water (i.e. one gram binds between one and ten liters). As we age, the skin's natural ability to produce Hyaluronic Acid depletes and wrinkles start to form and deepen.

Learn More
Glycine Saponin

Glycine Saponin, also known as Glycine Soja Germ Extract, is an active ingredient extracted from the soya bean. It is one of the most effective stimulators of Hyaluronic Acid in cells in the dermal layer of skin and has been proven to increase Hyaluronic Acid production by up to 256% on cell level*.

* Study report: Saponins – a new generation of Hyaluronan-stimulating actives for human skin, S. Gallinat, F. Rippke, C. Keppler, J. Mergell, A. Bürger, F. Stäb, H.Wenck Beiersdorf AG, Hamburg, Germany

Learn More
Enoxolone

Enoxolone, also known as Glycyrrhetinic Acid, is derived from the roots of Glycyrrhiza glabra (liquorice plant) and is well known in traditional Chinese medicine. It is a pentacyclic triterpenoid with anti‑inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. 

Enoxolone helps preserve levels of Hyaluronic Acid and elastin by protecting them against enzymatic degradation by hyaluronidase, and supports the skin’s own repair mechanisms against UV‑induced DNA damage.

FAQ

What is epigenetics and how does it affect the skin?

Epigenetics explores how genes operate and how one’s lifestyle influences them, ultimately leading to signs of skin ageing. After 15 years of research, Eucerin scientists have found that these epigenetic changes determining your skin age can be reversed through targeted epigenetic skincare solutions.

What is Eucerin’s patented Age Clock Technology?

Patented Age Clock Technology is a novel algorithm based on the epigenetic patterns of young and aged skin, which can measure the skin’s biological age. This groundbreaking technology also enabled Eucerin scientists to discover the active ingredient Epicelline®.

What age should I start using the Epigenetic Day Care SPF 30?

While skin ages differently depending on genetics and lifestyle, signs of ageing typically begin to appear in the late twenties and early thirties. This is why we recommend starting to use the Epigenetic Day Care SPF 30 at this stage.

Can I apply the Epigenetic Day Care SPF 30 to the entire face or only to specific areas?

The Day Care SPF 30 can be applied liberally to the entire face, neck and décolleté. Avoid contact with the eyes.

    Great daytime skincare
    Overall I liked this moisturiser. I have really oily skin so before I tried this I wouldn’t bother using moisturiser in the morning because it would make my skin oily and destroy my makeup. I’m not sure I’ve noticed all the anti-aging effects they claim, but in general my skin looks good so I can’t complain!
